one_line_conclusion: The six JIT Steel public business targets should be split into contractor/partner-route accounts and industrial-logistics real-estate operators; neither group proves active sourcing demand, so outreach must stay exploratory and evidence-led.

groups.group_name: Large EPC / turnkey contractor partner route
facts: Orascom Construction publicly positions as a global engineering and construction contractor focused on infrastructure, industrial and high-end commercial projects across the Middle East, Africa and the United States.
Hassan Allam publicly describes large-scale engineering and construction work across Egypt and MENA, with sectors including industrial plants and buildings, and notes structural steelwork capability.
ASGC publicly positions as a vertically integrated construction group in the UAE delivering turnkey special projects across commercial, industrial, oil and gas, infrastructure and transport sectors.
inferences: These accounts may be more suitable for a subcontractor, fabrication partner, or project support conversation than a simple supplier pitch.
Hassan Allam and ASGC have in-house or integrated capabilities, so direct category overlap and vendor approval barriers should be expected.
No current steel-structure sourcing demand is proven.
groups.outreach_angle: Position JIT Steel as a steel-structure fabrication and project support option for selected industrial, warehouse, or large-span building scopes, while asking whether partnership or subcontractor registration is the right route.

Exploring a project-support route for steel building packages
Prefab steel structure support for EPC project teams
groups.first_email_draft:
Hi {{first_name}},

I saw that {{company_name}} works on large engineering and construction projects across industrial, infrastructure, or commercial sectors.

JIT Steel Buildings supports prefabricated steel structure projects, including warehouses, workshops, factories, hangars, and large-span buildings, covering design coordination, fabrication, shipment, and project support.

I do not want to assume you are sourcing this scope now. If your team ever reviews external steel-structure fabrication or project support partners for selected packages, I can share a short capability overview and project-fit checklist.

Best,
{{sender_name}}
groups.follow_up_cadence: Follow up once after 5-7 working days with a concise capability sheet and ask whether vendor registration, subcontractor qualification, or project BD is the right route.
human_review_points: Confirm whether the right entry point is procurement, subcontractor registration, project controls, or business development.
Check whether the company has internal structural steel fabrication that would make JIT a competitor rather than partner.
Do not send standard buyer-style pricing language before route confirmation.

groups.group_name: Industrial / logistics real-estate operator and project owner route
facts: Agility Logistics Parks publicly describes developing and operating Grade A warehousing and light-industrial parks across the Middle East, Africa and South Asia.
KEZAD Group publicly describes operating integrated economic cities, free zones, industrial real estate solutions, industrial zones, and logistics supply chains in Abu Dhabi.

Tatu City publicly describes Tatu Industrial Park as a logistics park and private Special Economic Zone in East Africa, with development-ready land, operating industrial firms, and flexible warehouses for lease.
inferences: These accounts may be relevant when they plan new warehouses, industrial units, built-to-suit facilities, or expansion phases.
The better route is project owner / real-estate development discovery, not a generic construction supplier email.
No current project tender or steel-building requirement is proven.
groups.outreach_angle: Use a development-support angle: prefabricated steel structures for warehouse, workshop, and light-industrial expansion projects, with the first ask focused on whether upcoming phases or built-to-suit projects exist.
